reason: This rule aligns with the contradiction pattern as it asserts that if biscuits are for sale in a city and are available, then both types of biscuits should also be available in that city. This creates a logical inconsistency if the premises are true but the conclusion does not hold.
refined_position: Logical inconsistency due to the failure of the conclusion to hold when the premises are true regarding the availability of both types of biscuits in the city.
reflecting_rules: - 1. Q[x0, y0](for_sale_in(city, pretty_tins_of_biscuits) ∧ is_available(biscuits, in_city) → is_available_in(city, both_types_of_biscuits))
